title: Feandrea Foldable Travel Crate for Dogs and Cats, 60cm, Grey
description:
## About the Feandrea Foldable Travel Crate

The Feandrea Foldable Travel Crate is a soft-sided carrier for pet owners who want something sturdier than a simple bag-style carrier but still easy to fold away between trips. A lightweight steel frame keeps its shape while your pet is inside, and the whole crate collapses flat to roughly 60cm x 42cm x 8cm when you are done, so it tucks into a car boot or cupboard without taking up permanent space.

It suits [small dogs](/carriers/dog-carriers/small-dog-carriers) in the 7 to 11kg range, as well as cats who prefer a roomier, more open carrier than a hard box style. Because it opens out into a proper crate shape rather than a narrow bag, pets have enough room to turn around, lie down and settle in for longer journeys.

## Key Features

### Steel Frame with Fold-Flat Design

A metal frame supports the 600D Oxford fabric body, so the crate holds its shape properly while your pet is inside rather than collapsing in on them. Once you are finished, unclip the frame and it folds flat for storage.

### Mesh Doors and Windows

Mesh panels run along the doors and windows, giving your dog or cat a good view out and steady airflow. This also helps nervous pets feel less shut in, since they can see you are close by.

### Storage Pockets

Two side pockets built into the crate hold small items such as a lead, treats or a water bottle, so there is no need to carry a separate bag for short trips.

### Removable Base Mat

A soft, easy-clean mat lines the base for comfort. Lift it out between uses to keep the crate fresh.

## Who This Crate Is Best For

This [dog carrier](/carriers/dog-carriers) and [cat carrier](/carriers/cat-carriers) suits:

- Small to medium dogs weighing roughly 7 to 11kg (Toy Poodles, Corgis, French Bulldogs and similar breeds)
- Cats who prefer more room to move than a hard box-style carrier
- [Car journeys](/carriers/car-travel-carriers) and [vet visits](/carriers/vet-visit-carriers), thanks to the fold-flat storage
- Camping trips, hotel stays or as an occasional indoor den at home
- Owners who want a [soft-sided carrier](/carriers/soft-sided-carriers) that still holds its shape properly

## Care Instructions

Wipe down the fabric exterior with a damp cloth. Lift out the base mat to shake off loose hair and spot clean as needed. Let everything dry fully before folding away, to stop any musty smell developing in storage.

title: Lionto Foldable Dog Crate for Travel and Car, 60cm, Grey
description:
## About the Lionto Foldable Dog Crate

The Lionto Foldable Dog Crate is a fabric and steel-tube crate designed for car travel, house training and everyday resting at home. Oxford fabric stretched over a lightweight steel frame keeps the crate stable while your dog is inside, and it folds down flat when you do not need it, so it does not take up permanent floor space.

A padded reclining cushion with a removable cover lines the base, giving your dog a comfortable spot to settle whether you are on a long drive or they are having a quiet nap at home. Because the crate keeps its shape and has a defined sleeping area, it also works well as part of house training, since most puppies avoid soiling the space they sleep in.

## Key Features

### Steel Tube Frame

Durable, lightweight steel tubes support the fabric body, so the crate holds its shape properly rather than sagging once your dog climbs in.

### Mesh Windows and Zip Access

Mesh netting on the sides and front gives good airflow and lets your dog see out, while zips at the top and front make it easy to get them in and out.

### Padded Cushion Base

A cosy reclining cushion with a removable cover sits inside the base. Take it out to freshen up between uses.

### Fold-Flat Storage

When you do not need the crate, it folds flat for easy storage in a car boot, cupboard or under a bed.

### Carry Handle and Side Pockets

A sturdy carry handle makes it easy to move between the car and the house, and two side pockets hold small items like treats or a lead.

## Who This Crate Is Best For

This [dog carrier](/carriers/dog-carriers) suits:

- Small to medium dogs who need a stable, comfortable crate for car journeys
- Puppies going through house training, thanks to the defined sleeping area
- Owners who want a [car travel](/carriers/car-travel-carriers) crate that doubles as an everyday resting spot at home
- Trips to the [vet](/carriers/vet-visit-carriers) or short stays away from home
- Anyone who wants a crate that folds away flat rather than a rigid plastic carrier taking up storage space

## Care Instructions

Remove the cushion cover and wash it separately according to its care label. Wipe the fabric shell with a damp cloth and let everything dry fully before folding the crate away for storage.

title: Conlun Collapsible Soft-Sided Carrier for Cats and Small Dogs, Purple
description:
## About the Conlun Collapsible Carrier

The Conlun Collapsible Carrier is a soft-sided bag-style carrier built for large cats and small to medium dogs up to 10kg. A steel frame inside the polyester body keeps its shape in use, while self-locking zippers mean your pet cannot nudge their way out mid-journey. It is designed for car rides and everyday trips rather than air travel, so it suits owners who need a comfortable, secure carrier for local journeys, vet visits and days out.

It works well as a carrier for larger cat breeds who need a bit more room, and as a small dog carrier for puppies and smaller adult dogs. Always measure your pet's length, height and weight against the carrier's dimensions before buying, to make sure they will be comfortable inside.

## Key Features

### Self-Locking Zippers and Safety Leash

The main zippers lock shut so an inquisitive pet cannot work them open from the inside. An internal safety leash clips onto a harness or collar for extra reassurance during the journey.

### Breathable Mesh on Three Sides

Mesh panels on three sides and an openable top let fresh air in and give your pet a view out, which helps keep them settled rather than feeling shut away.

### External Storage Pockets

Pockets on the outside of the carrier hold small essentials like treats, a lead or waste bags, so you do not need to carry a separate bag for short trips.

### Removable, Washable Base Mat

A soft fleece mat lines the base for comfort and lifts out for hand or machine washing.

### Padded Strap and Carry Handles

Carry it by the top handles or use the adjustable, padded shoulder strap for hands-free trips.

## Who This Carrier Is Best For

- Large cat breeds who need more room than a standard cat carrier
- Small to medium dogs and puppies up to around 10kg
- Car journeys and vet visits
- Owners who want a soft-sided carrier that still holds its shape
- Everyday errands where a lightweight, foldable carrier is easier to store between trips

This carrier is not certified for air travel, so it is best kept for car journeys and everyday outings rather than flights.

## Care Instructions

Wipe the polyester exterior down with a damp cloth. Remove the fleece base mat to hand wash or machine wash on a gentle cycle, and let it dry fully before folding the carrier away for storage.

Mesh panels across the top and sides let your cat see out and keep air moving, while a zip opening on each side makes it easy to settle your pet in or lift them out. A safety belt buckle lets you secure the carrier with a normal vehicle seatbelt for car journeys.

This carrier suits small cats and similarly sized small pets who need a lightweight, soft-sided option for travel days and car trips alike.

Generous mesh panelling across the top and sides keeps your cat cool, gives them a view out, and helps ease anxiety during the journey.

### Two-Sided Access

Zip openings on both sides make it straightforward to get your cat in and out without a struggle.

### Vehicle Seatbelt Buckle

A safety belt buckle allows the carrier to be restrained using a standard car seatbelt, keeping it steady on car journeys.

### Lightweight, Water-Resistant Build

Made from durable, lightweight nylon and mesh materials that fold away easily when not in use.

- Small cats and similarly sized small pets, up to around 4kg

title: DPWEION Foldable Soft-Sided Pet Carrier for Cats and Small Dogs, Grey
description:
## About the DPWEION Foldable Pet Carrier

The DPWEION carrier is a soft-sided, foldable travel bag built for [small dogs](/carriers/dog-carriers/small-dog-carriers) and cats who need a comfortable, secure way to get from A to B. A steel frame and wooden support board keep the bag's shape steady rather than collapsing in on your pet, while mesh panels on all four sides let air circulate and give your pet a clear view out.

It suits pets up to around 7.3kg (16lbs), though as with any carrier it is worth checking your pet's length and height as well as their weight before choosing a size. The [soft-sided](/carriers/soft-sided-carriers) design folds flat for storage between trips, and a front pocket keeps small essentials like treats or a lead close to hand.

## Key Features

### Steel Frame with Four-Sided Mesh

A sturdy steel frame and wooden support board hold the carrier's shape, so it does not sag or wobble when your pet moves around inside. Mesh windows on all four sides keep air moving and let your pet see their surroundings, which can help them feel less closed in during the journey.

### Airline-Sized and Car Ready

The carrier is sized to fit under most aeroplane seats and includes four non-slip feet to help stop it sliding around in a car or on a bus seat. It can also be fastened using a [car seatbelt](/carriers/car-travel-carriers) or the adjustable shoulder strap, giving you a couple of ways to keep it steady on the move.

### Removable, Washable Pad

The soft pad inside lifts out for washing, and the outer fabric wipes clean with a damp cloth, so everyday muck from paws or accidents is easy to deal with.

### Folds Flat with a Front Pocket

When it is not in use, the carrier folds down flat to save space in a cupboard or car boot. A front pocket gives you somewhere to keep small items like treats, poo bags or a spare lead.

## Who This Carrier Is Best For

This carrier suits:

- Small dogs and cats up to around 7.3kg (16lbs)
- Owners taking car journeys who want a carrier that can be belted in securely
- [Cat owners](/carriers/cat-carriers) who want a soft, foldable option rather than a rigid box carrier
- Nervous pets who benefit from mesh windows on every side for airflow and visibility
- Anyone who wants a carrier that folds away flat between trips

## Care Instructions

Remove the internal pad and wash it according to the care label, then leave it to dry fully before putting it back in the carrier. Wipe the outer fabric down with a damp cloth for everyday marks, and let the whole carrier air dry before folding it away, to avoid a musty smell building up in storage.

title: Pecute Extra Large Cat and Dog Carrier with Panoramic Windows, Green
description:
## About the Pecute Extra Large Carrier

This Pecute carrier is a spacious, soft-sided travel bag built around a 5mm high-tensile steel wire frame, giving it a dome shape that holds firm rather than collapsing under pressure. It is around 3cm wider on each side than a standard [carrier](/carriers), so there is genuinely more room inside for a [large cat](/carriers/cat-carriers/large-cat-carriers) or a small dog to sit and turn around.

Three-sided double-layer mesh windows keep air moving and are scratch resistant, while a pair of clear panoramic windows let your pet see out. An automatic safety lock zip, which can only be opened from the outside, and an adjustable internal safety leash are both included to reduce the risk of a nervous pet pushing their way out mid-journey.

## Key Features

### Reinforced Steel Wire Frame

A 5mm high-tensile steel wire frame keeps the carrier's dome shape rigid, so it stays stable and impact resistant rather than flexing under your pet's weight or an accidental knock.

### Breathable Mesh on Three Sides

Double-layer nylon mesh windows on three sides boost airflow and help stop the inside of the carrier overheating, while the scratch-resistant weave stands up to claws better than a standard single-layer mesh.

### Double Escape-Proof System

An automatic safety lock zip that only opens from the outside, combined with an adjustable internal safety leash, gives you two layers of protection against an anxious pet working a zip open in a busy public space.

### Secure Car Fitting

A detachable wide shoulder strap and carry handle make it easy to switch how you carry it, and it locks onto a car seatbelt so it will not slide around under sudden braking.

### Washable Mat and Storage Pockets

A machine-washable plush mat lines the base for comfort, and side storage pockets give you somewhere to keep a lead, treats or waste bags without needing a separate bag.

## Who This Carrier Is Best For

This carrier suits:

- Large cats and small to medium dogs who need extra room to turn around
- Owners who want the reassurance of a double escape-proof zip and leash system
- [Hiking](/carriers/hiking-pet-carriers), walking and day trips, thanks to the breathable mesh and panoramic windows
- Car journeys, with a strap that locks onto a standard seatbelt
- Pets who feel calmer being able to see out through clear windows rather than being fully enclosed

## Care Instructions

The plush base mat is machine washable, so remove it and wash according to its care label, then let it dry fully before putting it back in the carrier. Wipe the outer fabric and mesh panels down with a damp cloth for everyday marks, and leave the whole carrier open to air dry before folding it away for storage.

## A Note on Availability

At the time this listing was imported, this exact size and colour (and its sibling variants) were showing as "Currently unavailable" on Amazon UK, with no purchasable offer. This product is saved as a draft and is not yet visible in the shop. Once a verified price and stock are confirmed it can be published from the admin panel.
